changes: Auto-update ab khamoshi se fail nahi hoga: helper ke start ki tasdeeq (update log me 'helper start' line) ke baghair app band nahi hoti — helper block ho to purani version chalti rehti hai aur saaf error milta hai.
Pichli update fail ho to agli boot par MUSTAQIL notice dikhega (sirf log me nahi) — wajah ke sath Dobara Check aur Update Folder kholne ke buttons.
Folder copy se chalane par wazeh notice: updates installed jagah par lagte hain, is liye installed version kholne ka button diya gaya hai (kuch delete nahi hota).
notes: Naya version v1.2.11 tayyar hai (aap ke paas v1.2.10 hai). Auto-update loop ka permanent fix — is dafa INSTALLER se manually update karein, phir fixed updater agli updates khud sambhalega.
